reviews.briefA: blocked round 1: packaged Electron evidence predated HEAD and type-check/build had not run. Resolved by building AppImage 09ac4dad from this HEAD (embedded UI 50070284) and verifying packaged flows, plus green UI type-check/build. Nonblocking: 6f1fe19fe edits en/zh-CN settings dictionaries for the OMP nav label; locale parity passes and this verification made no dictionary edits.

limitations: No official external provider key or OAuth consent grant was used; OAuth proof covers the native modal, real authorization URL, manual callback prompt, and cancel only.
Model discovery used a deterministic local OpenAI-compatible fixture at 127.0.0.1:4621; no third-party endpoint was contacted.

Electron evidence is the current-HEAD rebundle AppImage 09ac4dad.../linux-unpacked; the packaging script exit 1 after artifact creation was electron-builder implicit publish requiring GH_TOKEN, not a packaging failure.
Hosted/Capacitor surfaces share the Host/UI but were not launched; they do not run the local worker.
